title:
How many matches were held in the league Germany 1. Bundesliga
from August

prediction.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Match AS m
JOIN League AS l ON m.XCL_008 = l.XCL_003
WHERE l.XCL_005 = 'Germany 1. Bundesliga'
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', m.XCL_011) BETWEEN '2008-08' AND '2008-10';
